title: Terms & Conditions
subtitle: Rules and regulations governing admissions, website use, and academic enrollment at Bareilly International University (BIU).

sections.title: 1. Admissions & Eligibility
content: Admissions to professional courses (MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, B.Pharm, MBA, Law) are strictly subject to eligibility criteria, qualifying entrance cutoffs, and document verification by BIU Admission Cell.
Submission of fraudulent documents or misrepresentation of academic scores will lead to immediate cancellation of admission and legal action as per University statutes.

sections.title: 2. Academic Conduct & Regulations
content: Enrolled students are bound by University discipline, anti-ragging codes, 75% mandatory lecture attendance, and code of conduct outlined by respective regulatory councils (NMC, DCI, PCI, BCI).
